cache: ../.cache, beside the repository; every bake reads its source from there unless given a path
note: The copies in ../.cache were downloaded before this file existed and nobody wrote down from where. The URLs are each file's canonical source; sha256 and bytes are of the copy the bakes were last run against, so `node scripts/fetch-sources.mjs` says when what it downloads is not that copy. GeoNames rebuilds its dumps daily, so its hashes will drift; Natural Earth changes by release.

assets.what: The CC0 model packs build-cast.mjs, build-kit.ts and retarget-clips.ts read: Quaternius, Kenney, KayKit and Poly Pizza models
assets.note: Not fetched by fetch-sources.mjs: each pack is a download from its own site, and ../.cache/assets/INVENTORY.md lists every one with its URL, its licence and when it was taken. What each bake used is named in the LICENSE.txt it writes beside its output under public/models/.
assets.packsNote: Packs recorded since 2026-10-01, with where each was downloaded. A zip's sha256 and bytes are the zip's; a Google Drive folder's sha256 is of the sorted `sha256sum` lines of every file under it (`cd <file> && find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs -d '\n' sha256sum | sha256sum`) and its bytes the folder's total.
